1.w: Give thanks to YHWH, for [He is] good, for His loving devotion [is] forever!

2.w: Let the redeemed of YHWH say, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy,

3.w: and from the lands He has gathered them—from the east and from the west, from the north and from the sea.

4.w: They wandered in the wilderness, by the way in a desert; a city for of dwelling they did not find.

5.w: Hungry and thirsty, their soul in them grew faint.

6.w: And they cried out to YHWH in the distress for them; from their straits He delivered them.

7.w: And He made them tread on a straight path, to walk toward a city of dwelling.

8.w: Let them give thanks to YHWH for His loving devotion, and His wonders to the sons of man!

9.w: For He satisfies the rushing soul, and the hungry soul He fills with goodness.

10.w: They are sitting in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and irons,

11.w: because they rebelled against the words of God, and they despised the counsel of the Most High,

12.w: and He humbled with labor their heart; they fell down, and no one was helping.

13.w: And they cried out to YHWH in the distress for them, [and] from their straits He saved them.

14.w: He brought them forth from darkness and the shadow of death, and their bonds He broke away.

15.w: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion, and His wonders to the sons of man!

16.w: For He has broken down doors of bronze, and He has cut through bars of iron!

17.w: Fools from the path of their transgression, and by their iniquities they were afflicted.

18.w: All food their soul abhorred, and they drew near to the gates of death.

19.w: And they cried out to YHWH in the distress for them, [and] from their straits He saved them.

20.w: He sent His word and healed them, and He rescued them from the Pit.

21.w: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion, and His wonders to the sons of man!

22.w: And let them sacrifice sacrifices of thanksgiving, and recount His works with rejoicing!

23.w: Those going down to the sea in ships, doing business on the great waters,

24.w: they have seen the works of YHWH, and His wonders in the deep.

25.w: And He spoke and stationed the wind, a tempest, and it lifted high the waves;

26.w: they went up [to] the heavens, they went down [to] the depths; their soul melted in evil.

27.w: They reel and stagger like the drunkard, and all their wisdom is swallowed up.

28.w: And they cried out to YHWH in the distress for them, and from their straits He brought them out.

29.w: He stilled the tempest to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.

30.w: And they rejoiced because they grew quiet, and He guided them to the haven of their desire.

31.w: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of man!

32.w: And let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people, and in the seat of the elders praise Him!

33.w: He turns rivers into a wilderness, and outpourings of waters into thirsty ground,

34.w: a land of fruit into salty ground, from the wickedness of those dwelling in it.

35.w: He turns the desert into pools of water, and a land of dryness into springs of waters.

36.w: And the hungry He makes to dwell there, that they may establish a city for a dwelling place.

37.w: And there they sow fields and plant vineyards, that they may yield the fruit of produce.

38.w: And He blesses them and they multiply exceedingly, and their cattle He does not let diminish.

39.w: When they are diminished and brought low from oppression, evil, and sorrow,

40.w: He pours out contempt on nobles, and causes them to wander in a wasteland without a path.

41.w: And He sets on high [for] the needy from affliction, and He places families as a flock.

42.w: Let the upright see and rejoice, and may all iniquity shut its mouth.

43.w: And [him] who [is] wise, let him attend to these things, and they will consider the loving devotion of YHWH.
